newsitem.title: UK: Finance sector makes up 20 pct Scottish GDP - SFA.
newsitem.headline: Finance sector makes up 20 pct Scottish GDP - SFA.

text.p: The finance and business sectors account for some 20 percent of gross national product in Scotland and around one in seven Scottish jobs, according to a report from consultancy Scottish Financial Enterprise (SFA).
Scottish-based specialist fund managers now control more than 50 billion stg, a four-fold increase since 1986.
One third of UK investment trusts are managed in Scotland, including two of the largest self-managed trusts, the Alliance Trust and the Scottish Investment Trust.
"The recent merger between two of the specialist fund managers, Dunedin and Edinburgh Fund Managers, created the third largest investment trust management company in the UK," the report said.

It also noted that clearing banks with headquarters in Scotland had total assets of 96 billion stg and employed 46,700 people in the UK. They are also pioneering systems for treasury management and cross-border fund transfer.
The stock exchange in Glasgow, a unit of the London Stock Exchange, handles between one third and one half of all UK transactions by private investors, SFA said.
